gaps.sentence: She was brought ___ by her grandparents.
gaps.explanation: bring up a child = raise, educate them.

gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
They're ___ up a new office in the old warehouse district.
The hotel was full, so we couldn't check ___.
gaps.explanation: check in = register; check out = leave and pay.

gaps.sentence: The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.

gaps.sentence: They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
They set ___ to climb the north face in April.
gaps.explanation: set out (to do) = begin a job/mission with a goal.

gaps.sentence: They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).
